kamloops.title: Okanagan communities rally around Bald Range wildfire evacuees
kamloops.description: For many evacuees, the immediate challenge was finding somewhere to sleep, something to eat and the basic necessities they had suddenly left behind.

kamloops.title: All evacuation orders downgraded for Quilpituk Creek wildfire, residents return home
kamloops.description: All residents who were forced out of their homes due to the Quilpituk Creek wildfire, burning north of West Kelowna, were allowed to go home on Friday.

kamloops.title: Peachland residents to return home Friday, 1 week after Bald Range fire started
kamloops.description: As of 6 p.m. on Aug. 14, evacuation orders for all properties in Peachland and Electoral Area West will be downgraded to evacuation alerts, officials say.

kamloops.title: Bald Range wildfire: New orders issued as some residents allowed home
kamloops.description: Erin Catherall said structural protection and firefighters continue to work on the southern flank, which is the area around Mt. Conkle, with Penticton to the south.

kamloops.title: Residents describe returning home as fire evacuation orders lift in Okanagan
kamloops.description: On Friday, evacuation orders were lifted for 2,400 residences around the Quilpituk Creek fire zone, as well as in Peachland and Trout Creek where the Bald Range fire continues to burn.

southeast.title: Young grizzly bear with limp killed in Nelson, B.C., sparks rally
southeast.description: In an update on Friday, B.C. Conservation Officer Service said the young bear's mother has now also been killed to ensure public safety after the wild animal exhibited food-conditioned behaviour and loss of fear to people.

all.title: Fire and Climate – a special and timely collection
all.description: The 2026 wildfire season shows us that with increased wildland fire risk, more intense fire behaviour, longer seasons, and fire evolving across many landscapes, a changing climate poses significant challenges to today’s fire regimes and management strategies. The International Journal of Wildland Fire has published a Special Collection to showcase papers from and inspired by […]

all.title: Canadair water-bomber builder feels heat of demand as wildfires rage around the world
all.description: As Canada, the United States and Europe grapple with another brutal wildfire season, pressure is building on the manufacturer of the Canadair "Super Scooper" water bombers to increase production, and on the federal government to bulk order the planes.

all.title: Thousands of residents in B.C.'s Interior can return home as some evacuation orders downgraded to alerts
all.description: B.C. residents in some wildfire areas will be able to return to their homes Friday, as some evacuation orders are downgraded to alerts.

all.title: Hockey Night in Canada: Punjabi Edition not returning after 18 years
all.description: Hockey Night in Canada: Punjabi Edition has been cancelled after 18 years on the air, the show announced Friday.

all.title: 560 wildfires in B.C. have been classified as arson or suspicious since 2016: BCWS
all.description: The B.C. Wildfire Service says 3.8 per cent of wildfires are considered 'incendiary' fires, which means fires that were started either intentionally or by negligence. The cause of several major B.C. wildfires, including the Bald Range fire, are under investigation.
